nodes.name: ZIF-8 Synthesis
nodes.procedure: Zn(NO3)2·6H2O (1.118 g) was dispersed in 30 mL of methanol, which was subsequently injected into 30 mL of methanol containing 2.627 g 2-methylimidazole (MeIM) under ultrasound for 5 min at room temperature. Then, the resulting dispersion was stirred for 4 h at room temperature. The obtained product was separated by centrifugation and washed subsequently with methanol several times and finally dried at 70 °C under vacuum for overnight.
nodes.source_text: 2.2. Preparation of ZIF-8 ... dried at 70 °C under vacuum for overnight.

nodes.name: ZIF-67 Synthesis
nodes.procedure: Co(NO3)2·6H2O (1.092 g) was dispersed in 30 mL of methanol, which was subsequently injected into 120 mL of methanol containing 1.232 g 2-methylimidazole (MeIM) under ultrasound for 5 min at room temperature. Then, the resulting dispersion was stirred for 4 h at room temperature. The resulting ZIF-67 crystals were collected by centrifugation and washed with methanol several times and dried in vacuum at 70 °C for overnight.
nodes.source_text: 2.3. Preparation of ZIF-67 ... dried in vacuum at 70 °C for overnight.

nodes.name: ZnCo-ZIF Synthesis
nodes.procedure: Co(NO3)2·6H2O (1.092 g) and Zn(NO3)2·6H2O (1.118 g) were dissolved in 75 mL methanol, which was subsequently injected into 30 mL of methanol containing 1.232 g 2-methylimidazole (MeIM) under ultrasound for 5 min at room temperature. The mixed solution was then stirred at room temperature for 4 h. The as-obtained precipitates were collected by centrifugation and washed with methanol several times, and finally dried in the vacuum drying oven at 70 °C for overnight.
nodes.source_text: 2.4. Preparation of ZnCo-ZIF ... dried in the vacuum drying oven at 70 °C for overnight.

nodes.name: Pyrolysis to N-C, Co-NPs/N-C, Co-SAs/N-C
nodes.procedure: The powder of ZIF-8, ZIF-67 and ZnCo-ZIF was placed in a tube furnace and then heated to 900 °C for 3 h under flowing Ar gas, followed by slow cooling to room temperature. The heating rate was 5 °C min-1.

unit_operations.name: Pyrolysis
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: heated to 900 °C for 3 h under flowing Ar gas

nodes.source_text: 2.5. Preparation of N-C, Co-NPs/N-C and Co-SAs/N-C ... heating rate was 5 °C min-1.

nodes.name: RuCl3 Impregnation (Multiple Supports)
nodes.procedure: The powder of XC-72, N-C, Co-NPs/N-C and Co-SAs/N-C (50 mg) was dispersed in 13 mL deionized water and stirred to form a clear solution, followed by the addition of 2 mL RuCl3·xH2O solution (30 mg mL-1). After agitated stirring at 70 °C for 16 h, the as-obtained products were centrifuged and rinsed several times by ethanol, and finally dried in vacuum at 70 °C for overnight.
nodes.source_text: 2.6. Preparation of RuCl3@C, RuCl3@N-C, RuCl3@Co-NPs/N-C and RuCl3@Co-SAs/N-C ... dried in vacuum at 70 °C for overnight.

nodes.name: Ru Clusters Pyrolysis (Multiple Supports)
nodes.procedure: Ru@C, Ru@N-C, Ru@Co-NPs/N-C and Ru@Co-SAs/N-C products were obtained by the pyrolysis of RuCl3@C, RuCl3@N-C, RuCl3@Co-NPs/N-C and RuCl3@Co-SAs/N-C at 125 °C for 1 h under Ar atmosphere, followed by slow cooling to room temperature.
nodes.source_text: 2.10. Preparation of Ru@C, Ru@N-C, Ru@Co-NPs/N-C and Ru@Co-SAs/N-C ... at 125 °C for 1 h under Ar atmosphere.

nodes.name: H2PtCl6 Impregnation on Co-SAs/N-C
nodes.procedure: Co-SAs/N-C (50 mg) was dispersed in 10 mL deionized water and stirred to form a clear solution, followed by the addition of 5 mL H2PtCl6 solution (30 mg mL-1). After agitated stirring at 70 °C for 16 h, the as-obtained products were centrifuged and rinsed several times by ethanol, and finally dried in vacuum at 70 °C for overnight.
nodes.source_text: 2.8. Preparation of H2PtCl6@Co-SAs/N-C ... dried in vacuum at 70 °C for overnight.

nodes.name: Pt@Co-SAs/N-C Pyrolysis
nodes.procedure: Pt@Co-SAs/N-C products were obtained by the pyrolysis of H2PtCl6@Co-SAs/N-C at 400 °C for 1 h under Ar atmosphere, followed by slow cooling to room temperature.
nodes.source_text: 2.11. Preparation of Pt@Co-SAs/N-C ... pyrolysis of H2PtCl6@Co-SAs/N-C at 400 °C for 1 h.

nodes.name: PdCl2 Impregnation on Co-SAs/N-C
nodes.procedure: The powder of Co-SAs/N-C (50 mg) was dispersed in 11.58 mL deionized water and stirred to form a clear solution, followed by the addition of 1.71 mL PdCl2 acid solution (30 mg mL-1) and 1.71 mL KOH solution (0.1 mol L-1). After agitated stirring at 70 °C for 16 h, the as-obtained product was centrifuged and rinsed several times by ethanol, and finally dried in vacuum at 70 °C for overnight.
nodes.source_text: 2.9. Preparation of PdCl2@Co-SAs/N-C ... dried in vacuum at 70 °C for overnight.

nodes.name: Pd@Co-SAs/N-C Pyrolysis
nodes.procedure: Pd@Co-SAs/N-C products were obtained by the pyrolysis of PdCl2@Co-SAs/N-C at 200 °C for 1 h.
nodes.source_text: 2.12. Preparation of Pd@Co-SAs/N-C ... pyrolysis of PdCl2@Co-SAs/N-C at 200 °C for 1 h.
